## Checklist
- [ ] `python -m pytest` passes
- [ ] `python -m pyflakes api engine collector cpp tests` is clean
- [ ] New or changed behaviour has a test
- [ ] A new strategy uses only past data (no look-ahead) and has a short side, or says why not
- [ ] README or Changelog updated if users will notice the change
- [ ] No passwords, API keys or `.env` files included
